name: Sorcerer Pit-Touched
body:
Your diabolic corruption is from a source in the deepest parts of Hell.

Associated Bloodline: Infernal.

Bloodline Arcana

Whenever you cast a spell, you gain a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to the spell’s level for 1 round.

This ability replaces the Infernal Bloodline Arcana.

Bloodline Powers

The crushing weight of evil has given you the strength to endure.

Tough as Hell (Ex): At 9th level, you gain a +2 inherent bonus to your Constitution. This bonus increases to +4 at 13th level, and to +6 at 17th level.

This bloodline power replaces hellfire.
